image.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a small decorative photograph for a premium Russian hotel website FAQ sidebar, not a photograph of any particular real hotel. Generate a horizontal image, exact target 1680 by 840 pixels (2:1 aspect ratio). Primary subject: a polished classic silver reception service bell with a small brass button on a light beige marble reception counter, next to a clear glass vase of ivory white hydrangea flowers. Bell is near the center, flower vase on the right; preserve both important subjects within the central 70 percent so a curved upper-left corner crop can be applied by the website. Warm softly lit hotel lobby background with dark wooden vertical details, natural shallow depth of field; bell, marble and flowers crisply detailed, no excessive blur on subjects. Refined understated editorial hospitality photography, realistic reflections, soft daylight and warm ambience. Full bleed photography only. No text, logos, hotel names, UI, frames, watermarks or people.

preserved: All seven questions and original answers
